overview: Students and vocational director Heidi Riccio showcase technical coursework, robotics demonstrations, and expanding vocational programs.

items.title: Student Perspectives on Campus Integration
items.summary: Students discuss their daily shop coursework in electrical work and health vitals while highlighting their shared school campus.

items.title: Robotics and Technical Demonstrations
items.summary: Students demonstrate keyboard-controlled robot signaling and technical measurement techniques.

items.title: Tour of Vocational Programs
items.summary: Heidi Riccio highlights student cafeteria renovation work, licensing opportunities in cosmetology, college credit partnerships in culinary arts, and the construction of a mock hotel for hospitality training.
